items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions Salisand Ridley; Interviewee responds about Salisand's band history but does not claim a personal relationship or direct interaction with Salisand Ridley himself.

ctx.x: I know you usually travel a lot. Yeah, we did a lot of traveling. And went all around Florida, Alabama, Mississippi, Arkansas, Texas.
I've heard it sometime in the later days that Salisand had two bands. Did he have two in those days? Like one on the road one?
Well, no, he didn't have one band at that time. One band. That was before he went in the paddock. Yeah.
